messages:
Priya (PM): Need a crisp decision for GA: what observability widgets and tracing hooks ship in Console v1 so customers get cost transparency without overwhelming storage. Key asks: per-route cost breakdown, span-level costing, and error-linked trace retention.

Marcus (ENG): Backend can emit per-span cost estimates by assigning token weights to span length + payload. We can aggregate per-route by tagging spans with route_id. Default: route-level cost breakdown in dashboards; span-level costing available in Enterprise only.

Ellen (SRE): Ops wants safe defaults to prevent runaway bills. Proposal: dashboard shows "projected USD/24h" and a "cost anomaly" alert (threshold 25% uplift). For tracing hooks: keep sampling at 0.2% default, preserve error spans and spans for traced routes flagged in Console.

Ravi (Data): For error analytics, we should link stacktrace fingerprints to traces and surface "cost per error class" on the dashboard. Launch acceptance: for canary tenants, the dashboard must correctly attribute >=90% of observed error cost to the right error classes over 48h.

Priya (PM): UX decision: dashboard cards: 1) Per-route spend (top 20 routes) 2) Cost drift sparkline 3) Error-cost waterfall (grouped by error class) 4) Throttled tenants list. Add a simple filter to jump from a route cost to sample traces for that route.

Marcus (ENG): Implementation notes: we'll add route_id to trace metadata and a cost_estimate field to span proto. Example: {route_id: "api.v1.generate", cost_estimate_tokens: 120}. Console will roll up token->USD using tenant billing rate.

Ellen (SRE): Circuit-breaker: if projected tenant spend > $200/day, auto-drop span payloads (headers-only) and cap route visibility to top 10 by cost. Ops runbook: global revert to conservative sampling 0.05% if >5 tenants throttle in 24h.

Ravi (Data): For acceptance testing: create synthetic traffic for three canary tenants with different route mixes and verify attribution and error-cost signals. Measurement: >=90% attribution accuracy and alert firing on injected 30% cost spike.

Priya (PM): Launch checklist draft:
- Route tagging + span cost field (owner: Marcus)
- Dashboard cards + drilldown to traces (owner: Marcus)
- Budget enforcement + throttle UX + runbook (owner: Ellen)
- Error-cost attribution eval + canary tenants (owner: Ravi)
- Docs explaining expected visibility & enterprise features (owner: Priya)

NotifierBot: Jira RD-4021 created: "route-costing + error-linked retention" assigned to @Marcus.

Marcus (ENG): Timeline: core trace proto change + cost rollup in 2 sprints, dashboard widgets sprint 3, throttle integration parallel sprint 2.

Ellen (SRE): I'll draft runbook entries and thresholds. Add a kill-switch to disable span payload capture globally.

Priya (PM): OK. Action items: Marcus push proto PR and a minimal Console mock by Wed; Ellen draft runbook thresholds; Ravi seed canary tenants and synthetic workloads. We'll review on Friday 9am to finalize launch acceptance wording. :thumbsup:
